title: World Modeling through Spectral Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2610.15429v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: How do we tell a world model what information to preserve? We study this question through the lens of spectral representation learning. We introduce SpecWM, a JEPA framework that explicitly specifies desired relationships between observations through a target similarity kernel and trains the encoder to reproduce those relationships in its embedding geometry. Different kernels provide different supervision, ranging from physical state information to a fully self-supervised temporal kernel requiring only the ordering of observations within trajectories. We characterize the global optima of the objective, establish conditions for linear recoverability and invariance to nuisance information, and connect temporal-kernel similarity to the behavioral successor measure under an idealized setting. translated_title: 通过谱对齐实现世界建模
translated_abstract: 我们如何告诉世界模型需要保留哪些信息？我们从谱表示学习的视角来研究这个问题。我们提出了SpecWM，这是一个JEPA框架，它通过目标相似度核显式地指定观测之间期望的关系，并训练编码器在其嵌入几何结构中复现这些关系。不同的核提供不同的监督信号，范围从物理状态信息到仅需轨迹内观测顺序的全自监督时间核。我们刻画了该目标函数的全局最优解，建立了线性可恢复性以及对干扰信息不变性的条件，并在理想化设置下将时间核相似度与行为后继度量联系起来。实证结果表明，核的选择强烈决定了哪些物理量可以从表示中恢复出来。更重要的是，时间谱……
tldr: SpecWM是一个通过目标相似度核显式指定观测间期望关系并训练编码器在嵌入空间中复现这些关系的JEPA世界建模框架，核的选择决定了哪些物理量可从表示中恢复，其中时间核仅需观测顺序即可实现全自监督学习。
en_tdlr: SpecWM is a JEPA world-modeling framework that explicitly specifies desired relationships between observations through a target similarity kernel and trains the encoder to reproduce them in its embedding geometry, where the choice of kernel determines which physical quantities are recoverable, with the temporal kernel enabling fully self-supervised learning from mere observation ordering.
